result:
All eight round-9 checks pass and I found no bugs. I didn't trust A's report: I re-ran everything with my own shims, my own test harness and my own CI replay script. The source didn't change while I was verifying: the diff hash was the same at the start and at the end.

| ID | Result | What I saw |
|---|---|---|
| R9-1 static | PASS | `bash -n` and `shellcheck` report nothing, and the shebang is the only `#` line. `check.yml` parses. Its diff is exactly the three allowed changes: apt step 10 → 13 min, `Build` step removed, E2E step renamed with the new `run:` line. The ffprobe step still runs before E2E. |
| R9-2 shims | PASS | In the "everything hangs and ignores TERM" case the run took 14.03 s against a printed worst case of 14 s, with no leftover `sleep`. With 3 attempts: 21.03 s against 21 s. The two cases that should succeed exit 0, and both failure cases exit 1. All 13 bad-input cases exit 2 and make no apt or sudo call. Putting the attempt timeout back as the recovery bound is caught: 20 s against a printed 16 s. |
| R9-3 budget | PASS | With defaults the script prints `worst case 640s`, and the step allows 780 s. The old pair was 750 s against 600 s. Under the hang test the old script printed no `worst case` line and only stopped when my 40 s outer timeout killed it. |
| R9-4 real apt | PASS | Run with real sudo: `worst case 640s`, `attempt 1/2 ok after 2s`, exit 0. I set `man-db/auto-update` to `true` first, and the script set it back to `false`. `ffprobe` and `xvfb-run` work. The packages were already installed, so this didn't do a fresh install; `xauth` is a hard dependency of `xvfb`, and a simulated install pulls it in. |
| R9-5 CI-order replay | PASS 3 of 3 | Each run started clean. The E2E step does the build itself, `--retries=0` and `--reporter=list,html` reach Playwright, 7/7 pass, and `playwright-report/index.html` is created. Step times: apt about 1.5 s, Electron libraries 2.2 s, check 10.6 s, ffprobe 0.8 s, build and E2E 5.9 s. |
| R9-6 gate | PASS | The full verify command exits 0: Biome 0 errors (9 warnings), type check clean, renderer 107/107, main 62/62, E2E 7/7. A separate E2E run with `--retries=0` also gives 7/7. |
| R9-7 real-app smoke | PASS | In the built app under xvfb: Open Folder, set Category `DOORWood`, Save shows "Tags saved", and after Rescan the row is "Tagged". ffprobe and music-metadata both read `ICAT=DOORWood`. |
| R9-8 ownership and docs | PASS | Only the three owned files changed. The Georgian docs section only adds lines and covers every required point. Its numbers (240/2/10/60, 640 s, 13 min) match the script and `check.yml`. |

`realVerified` is true for these local checks. I did not and cannot confirm the GitHub Actions run, so TM-T0-CI stays in progress until a green `Check` run is linked. That note is in the `blocked` field of the JSON, as in round 4, which also passed.

Two items for B, neither of which changes the result:
- **C-R9-02 (low):** in one of A's three replays the app's window didn't open within Playwright's 30 s `firstWindow` timeout, and one E2E test failed. That was the first Electron start on a fresh machine. It didn't happen in any of my three replays, but A had already started Electron in this job, so I couldn't repeat a truly cold start. The old `check.yml` had the same `--retries=0`, so this isn't new. Still, on a fresh GitHub runner one such timeout turns the whole run red. It needs a backlog item: a warm-up, or a longer timeout in `tests/**`, which was frozen this round.
- **C-R9-01 (info):** when a hung command has to be force-killed, bash prints `Killed` lines to stderr. That's noise in the CI log only; the script's own output lines and exit codes are unaffected.
